Guides applied: [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/ARCHITECTURE.md), [best-practices.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/best-practices.md), [nestjs-patterns.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/nestjs-patterns.md), [api-dtos-and-validation.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md), [security.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/security.md), [module-structure.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/module-structure.md), [caching-and-performance.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/caching-and-performance.md), [testing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/testing.md), [commits-and-prs.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md), [reviewing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md), [remarks.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md).

1. **[`Raw<T>` at the boundary](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md#L61)** — [src/datasources/billing-api/billing-api.service.ts:237](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/21153d5b21f32a3be4789c989b10ee107deb05f3/src/datasources/billing-api/billing-api.service.ts#L237) — `previewSubscriptionUpdate` and `updateSubscription` return bare `SubscriptionUpdatePreview`/`UpdateSubscriptionResult` and run `Schema.parse()` inside the datasource, so no repository owns the parse boundary (the PR description declares the conversion as a follow-up, which the rule does not waive). **Fix:** type both as `Promise<Raw<SubscriptionUpdatePreview>>` / `Promise<Raw<UpdateSubscriptionResult>>` returning `rawify(data)`, and move `SubscriptionUpdatePreviewSchema.parse()` / `UpdateSubscriptionResultSchema.parse()` into a `BillingRepository` under `src/modules/billing/domain/` that `BillingService` calls instead of `IBillingApi`.
2. **[No scope creep](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md#L31)** — [src/modules/billing/routes/billing.controller.ts:95](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/21153d5b21f32a3be4789c989b10ee107deb05f3/src/modules/billing/routes/billing.controller.ts#L95) — four pre-existing handlers (lines 95, 134, 160, 188) have their second `spaceUuid` binding switched to `uuidPipe`, a hardening neither new endpoint requires and which the `## Changes` section does not list. **Fix:** drop `uuidPipe` from those four bindings, leaving them as they were, and ship that hardening as its own PR; or record it as a bullet under `## Changes` and a line in `## Summary`.

**Verdict:** ❌ 2 finding(s)
